summary: Genenta Science S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the termination of its amended and restated license agreement with Ospedale San Raffaele S.r.l. relating to certain technology and intellectual property rights. The filing does not disclose any stake, price, premium, or deal structure. The board approved the termination as part of a strategic review and resource reallocation, with no material termination fee expected. The company will continue an ongoing glioblastoma multiforme clinical trial with two patients. This is not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring; it is a routine contract termination.
